inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL/MariaDB UUID-construction expression uses CONV to render integer values in hexadecimal text and LPAD to preserve fixed-width fragments.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent numeric-label conversion report. CONV renders fixed decimal identifiers in hexadecimal and base-36 text, while CASE classifies a NULL input; the source routine, bit arithmetic, random values, and UUID construction are not copied.

fixture_notes: Values 7301 and 7302 convert fixed decimal identifiers to hexadecimal and base-36 labels; 7303 is zero, and 7304 is NULL. The NULL state is classified explicitly rather than relying on an implicit conversion result.
determinism_notes: Label IDs and decimal values are fixed; output is ordered by the unique label ID with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE numeric_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, decimal_value BIGINT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT label_id, decimal_value, CONV(decimal_value, 10, 16) AS hexadecimal_label, CONV(decimal_value, 10, 36) AS base36_label, CASE WHEN decimal_value IS NULL THEN 'missing' ELSE 'present' END AS value_state FROM numeric_labels ORDER BY label_id
